versions.changelog:
- Added license metadata (MIT) to SKILL.md.
- Clarified documentation on how to look up endpoints and types using go doc and pkg.go.dev.
- Expanded instructions for method naming and endpoint usage based on OpenAPI operation IDs.
- Removed skill-card.md (now only SKILL.md remains).
- General documentation refinements for clarity and discoverability.

Initial release of go-calcom for Cal.com API v2.

- Provides an unofficial, typed Go client for Cal.com API v2, generated with oapi-codegen.
- Supports operations for bookings, event types, available slots, schedules, calendars, teams, webhooks, and user profiles.
- Requires Go toolchain and CALCOM_API_KEY for authentication.
- Guidance included for secure usage and when to use this package.
- Example Go usage demonstrated in documentation.
